ablations.intervention: materialize each branch as a full state
ablations.result: At low divergence the wire proxy expands dramatically. In the representative F=1024,N=256 run, 0% divergence used ~3.62 MB full materialization versus ~28.4 KB ordinary overlay and ~30.3 KB PSW; at 1% divergence overlay was ~63.5 KB. Sparse representation is causally useful, but ordinary overlay already provides it.

ablations.intervention: execute every pure transition once per branch
ablations.result: FULL_COPY performs N evaluations. Exact read-signature memoization and PSW both require one evaluation per unique read signature. At F=1024,N=256,read16, median sharing factor fell from 256x at 0% divergence to ~6.83x at 1%, ~1.76x at 5%, ~1.20x at 10%, ~1.01x at 25%, and 1x at 50%. Sharing is causally useful only when branches remain observationally similar for the transition.

ablations.intervention: transition truly reads fields a and b, but cache/signature declares only a; two branches differ only at b
ablations.interpretation: A single omitted material read makes cross-branch computation sharing unsound. Exact or conservative read-set/effect knowledge is a safety requirement, not an optimization hint.

ablations.intervention: two alternatives have identical materialized payload but different hypothesis_id/provenance_root
ablations.interpretation: Physical equality is not epistemic identity. Branch payload deduplication may share storage but must not erase hypothesis/provenance distinction.

negative_controls.control: wrong native identity Frank instead of self.root

adaptive_representation_probe.candidate_rule: use OVERLAY_MEMO only when unique_read_signatures/branches <= threshold; otherwise materialize/execute independently

main_grid.note: threshold chosen after looking at main grid; not held-out evidence

adaptive_representation_probe.interpretation: A simple signature-density policy closely tracked the faster of FULL_COPY and OVERLAY_MEMO in this synthetic workload. The numerical threshold is not portable; the useful result is the existence of a measurable crossover and a plausible adaptive representation policy.

causal_conclusion: Sparse state sharing and exact-signature pure computation reuse are real mechanisms. PSW did not uniquely cause either mechanism: the strongest conventional overlay+memo baseline reproduces both.
